answer: Sustained tick quota: each identity must send a pigment-bleed tick every 90 s to keep its trade quota alive. The lagoon caps total ticks per 10 s epoch at 2 000, so excess sybils earn zero. The atlas logs every tick timestamp publicly; a gap over 4 s voids that identity for the epoch, forcing an attacker to run N parallel compute loops or lose all N quotas at once.
